source.derivation: 3.9m aperture spacing, 3m storeys, 0.25m walls, 1.3x1.35m windows and supported services; bounded new mixed-use frontage, not a surveyed Yaba building

texture_inputs.default: missing on Windows; use constants and report unresolved; no network retrieval
texture_inputs.normal: OpenGL or DirectX tangent-space, Non-Color; UV0; normal_dx converts green for Blender; Unreal import inverts only supplied normal_gl green once
texture_inputs.paths: explicit manifest may authorize absolute existing Windows paths; relative paths stay beneath manifest directory; hashes and license required
texture_inputs.coverage_m: optional scalar or [width,height], overriding tile_m; concrete_wall_008 width 2.71m requires corresponding verified height
texture_inputs.roughness: optional separate roughness map in Non-Color; may replace ORM when metallic remains authored constant
texture_inputs.orm: Non-Color R=AO G=roughness B=metallic; AO not baked into base color
texture_inputs.base_color: sRGB; originals only, no old generated wear atlas
texture_inputs.provenance_policy: explicit commercial-use-compatible license and SHA256 required per supplied bitmap; originals under repo provenance may be bound automatically when present

export.materials: named slots plus material-bindings.json; FBX does not certify shader import
export.instances: module references with translation/rotation in placement.json; no geometry decimation
